result.topic_en: A list of general formulas of spherical trigonometry, including the cosine and sine rules, their differential forms, the half-angle formulas and Gauss's (Delambre's) analogies.
result.transcription:
Math. 32
(8) [-48/4-] 8
Formeln der sphaerischen Trigonometrie.
Allgemeine
* $\cos a = \cos b \cos c + \sin b \sin c \cos A$
$\partial a = \cos C . \partial b + \cos B . \partial c + \sin B \sin c . \partial A$
$\sin a \cos B = \cos b \sin c - \sin b \cos c \cos A$
* $\sin a \sin B = \sin b \sin A$
$\mathrm{cotg}\, a . \partial a - \mathrm{cotg}\, A . \partial A = \mathrm{cotg}\, b . \partial b - \mathrm{cotg}\, B . \partial B$
* $\cos A \cos c = \mathrm{cotg}\, b \sin c - \mathrm{cotg}\, B \sin A$
$\;\;2\;\;\;3\;\;\;\;\;\;\;1\;\;\;\;3\;\;\;\;\;\;\;\;4\;\;\;\;2$
$\sin C . \partial b = \sin b \cos C . \partial A + \cos a \sin B . \partial c + \sin a . \partial B$
$\sin A \cos b = \cos B \sin C + \sin B \cos C \cos a$
* $\cos A = - \cos B \cos C + \sin B \sin C \cos a$
$\partial A = - \cos c . \partial B - \cos b . \partial C + \sin B \sin c . \partial a$
$\sin \frac{1}{2} A = \sqrt{\frac{\sin \frac{1}{2}(a+b-c) . \sin \frac{1}{2}(a-b+c)}{\sin b \sin c}}$
$\cos \frac{1}{2} A = \sqrt{\frac{\sin \frac{1}{2}(a+b+c) . \sin \frac{1}{2}(b+c-a)}{\sin b \sin c}}$
$\cos \frac{1}{2} A . \sin \frac{1}{2}(b-c) = \sin \frac{1}{2}(B-C) . \sin \frac{1}{2} a$
$\sin \frac{1}{2} A . \sin \frac{1}{2}(b+c) = \cos \frac{1}{2}(B-C) . \sin \frac{1}{2} a$
$\cos \frac{1}{2} A . \cos \frac{1}{2}(b-c) = \sin \frac{1}{2}(B+C) . \cos \frac{1}{2} a$
$\sin \frac{1}{2} A . \cos \frac{1}{2}(b+c) = \cos \frac{1}{2}(B+C) . \cos \frac{1}{2} a$

methods.what: Spherical law of cosines for sides
methods.quote: $\cos a = \cos b \cos c + \sin b \sin c \cos A$

methods.what: Differential form of the side cosine rule
methods.quote: $\partial a = \cos C . \partial b + \cos B . \partial c + \sin B \sin c . \partial A$
$\sin a \cos B = \cos b \sin c - \sin b \cos c \cos A$

methods.what: Differential form of the sine rule
methods.quote: $\mathrm{cotg}\, a . \partial a - \mathrm{cotg}\, A . \partial A = \mathrm{cotg}\, b . \partial b - \mathrm{cotg}\, B . \partial B$

methods.what: Four-part (cotangent) formula, with numbering of parts
methods.quote: $\cos A \cos c = \mathrm{cotg}\, b \sin c - \mathrm{cotg}\, B \sin A$

methods.what: Differential relation corresponding to the cotangent formula
methods.quote: $\sin C . \partial b = \sin b \cos C . \partial A + \cos a \sin B . \partial c + \sin a . \partial B$
$\sin A \cos b = \cos B \sin C + \sin B \cos C \cos a$

methods.what: Spherical law of cosines for angles
methods.quote: $\cos A = - \cos B \cos C + \sin B \sin C \cos a$

methods.what: Differential form of the angle cosine rule
methods.quote: $\partial A = - \cos c . \partial B - \cos b . \partial C + \sin B \sin c . \partial a$
